name: Westfield Plaza Bonita
demographics: Westfield Plaza Bonita serves a diverse, working-class to middle-income demographic in the South Bay region, with a significant Hispanic population and multi-generational households. The trade area includes National City, Chula Vista, and southern San Diego communities, attracting value-conscious shoppers seeking affordable fashion, family dining, and convenient one-stop shopping. Primary visitors are families with children and young adults aged 18-45 who prioritize accessibility, variety, and practical retail options over luxury experiences.
description: Westfield Plaza Bonita is a premier enclosed shopping destination in National City featuring a diverse mix of national retailers, dining options, and entertainment venues. As part of the renowned Westfield portfolio, this mall offers shoppers a dynamic experience with the latest fashion trends, convenient amenities like Smart Parking and click-and-collect services, and a variety of food offerings from global chains to local eateries. The center serves as a vibrant community hub where visitors can shop, dine, socialize, and enjoy special events throughout the year.
summary: Westfield Plaza Bonita is a well-established regional mall in National City serving the South Bay area with mainstream retail brands and dining options. The center provides a complete shopping experience with modern conveniences and entertainment amenities typical of the Westfield brand.
